subject: Sandbox access & credit offset proposal for NimblePay pilot
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@nimblepay.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@nimblepay.com
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary sandbox access + credit top-up

Hi Jordan —

Quick context: we ran a 30-day pilot of Redwood for payment anomaly detection; the account's trial credits exhausted last week and our sandbox was locked. We still have active evaluation work to complete and a demo for our execs on June 8.

Could Redwood temporarily re-enable our sandbox for 14 days and apply a small one-off credit so we can finish the demo and finalize internal evaluation? We can provide a signed mutual action plan (MAP) that commits to a PO if the trial results meet SLAs.

Attached is the usage snippet showing what exhausted the balance. Appreciate a quick reply — this is time-sensitive.

Thanks,
Liam
Liam O'Connor
Head of ML, NimblePay
[Attachment: nimblepay_trial_usage.csv (CSV, 28 KB)]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@nimblepay.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary sandbox access + credit top-up

Hi Liam —

Thanks for the context and the usage file — that makes it clear where the burn hit. Short answer: yes, we can support a temporary re-enable plus an offset credit under a conditional MAP. Two options to unblock you quickly:

- Fast unblock (2–3 hour turnaround): re-enable the sandbox for 14 days with a one-off $2,000 credit. This is a goodwill/top-up we grant; procurement will need to sign the attached MAP within 7 business days.
- Conditional short extension: grant a 7-day access window immediately and apply a $1,000 credit once we receive a signed MAP.

Ben — can you confirm approval for the $2k goodwill for NimblePay under our pilot exception play? Marissa — can you prepare an onboarding checklist and a short MAP template I can send Liam?

Liam — attaching the MAP template and a brief credit-offset summary so procurement can review terms. If you want the full 14-day unblock, we need the signed MAP returned by next Thu (2027-05-27).

Next steps: choose option 1 or 2 and we'll move.

Best,
Jordan
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: credit-offset-summary.xlsx (XLSX, 12 KB)]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary sandbox access + credit top-up

Jordan —

Approved for the $2k one-off credit as a pilot make-good. Use the standard pilot exception code; condition on signed MAP and proof of expected executive demo date. Please log approval in the CRM and mark the credit as expiring at the end of the 14-day extension.

Also flag for CS: ensure we gate access to a test-only environment and throttle any heavy batch jobs to avoid repeat burn.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Sales Operations

> 
> Thanks for the context...

From: Liam O'Connor <liam@nimblepay.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@nimblepay.com, legal@nimblepay.com
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary sandbox access + credit top-up

Jordan / Ben / Marissa —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. We reviewed both options internally and procurement prefers Option 1 (14-day unblock with $2k offset) as long as the MAP is signed within the window. I've attached the signed MAP (executive sign-off) and included a note from Procurement confirming the PO cadence.

Please re-enable the sandbox and apply the credit; Marissa, if you can share the onboarding checklist and any recommended throttles that would be great.

Liam
[Attachment: nimblepay_signed_map.pdf (PDF, 45 KB)]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@nimblepay.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, procurement@nimblepay.com
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary sandbox access + credit top-up

Liam —

All set. Sandbox access restored as of 16:30 PT today; $2,000 trial credit applied to NimblePay account (expires 2027-06-11). We created a restricted test namespace and enabled rate limits to prevent accidental large-batch consumption.

Marissa attached the onboarding checklist and two quick throttling recommendations: limit concurrent chat requests to 3 and disable overnight batch runs in the sandbox. Ben — I've logged the approval and the credit in HubSpot (link below) per the pilot exception playbook.

Links & paperwork:
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/9843
- Stored MAP: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1a2b3cMAP

If you hit any blockers ahead of the June 8 exec demo, ping me directly and we'll escalate.

Cheers,
Jordan
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
